verdict.rationale: Marqeta is API-first with a full Core API, sandbox environment, and simulation endpoints that let you create, test, and drive transactions entirely programmatically (docs-2, docs-10, docs-14, docs-19), which supports headless/automated use including in CI-like test pipelines. However there is no explicit documentation of CI integration, SDKs for test automation, or headless tooling beyond the sandbox API itself. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples, official SDK/test-harness guidance for automated runs, and any mention of non-interactive auth/token flows suited for CI.
